items.source: The key to be used to store the field inside the document. Alias for value().
items.translation: 用于在文档中存储字段的键。是value()的别名。

items.source: Annotation to define custom metadata for document fields.
items.translation: 用于为文档字段定义自定义元数据的注释。

items.source: The order in which various fields shall be stored.
The order in which various fields shall be stored. Has to be a positive integer.
items.translation: 各字段的存储顺序。必须为正整数。
奥利弗·吉尔克，克里斯托夫·施特罗布

items.source: the order the field shall have in the document or -1 if undefined.
items.translation: 文档中该字段的顺序，或若未定义则为 -1。
